mapper.select:
SELECT ACCT_NO code, ACCT_NAME shortName
,SEQ_NO seqNo
FROM STL_CAPACCT_INFO
AND (ACCT_NO LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{param},'%')) OR ACCT_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{param},'%')))

SELECT DISTINCT A.PORTFOLIO_ID id, A.PORTFOLIO_NAME text FROM PTL_PORTFOLIO A INNER JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY T ON A.PORTFOLIO_ID = T.PORTFOLIO_ID
AND T.USER_ID = #{userId}
,TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL B, PTL_TRADE C
B.TRADE_ID = C.BUSI_NO AND C.PORTFOLIO_ID = A.PORTFOLIO_ID AND B.PS IN (#{HK01} , #{HK02})
AND (A.PORTFOLIO_ID LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{search},'%')) OR A.PORTFOLIO_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{search},'%')))

SELECT DISTINCT B.TRD_ACCT_ID id, C.ACCT_NAME text FROM PTL_SEC_ACCT A INNER JOIN STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO B ON A.ACCT_NO = B.SEC_ACCT_ID inner join STL_CAPACCT_INFO C on B.TRD_ACCT_ID = C.ACCT_NO
AND (B.TRD_ACCT_ID LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{search},'%')) OR C.ACCT_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{search},'%')))
AND A.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId}
AND B.TRADE_PLACE IN ('03','04')
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM PTL_CASH_POSITION_FLOW WHERE ORDER_ID = #{orderId} AND HODING_TYPE = #{holdingType}
